description: E-A input-class analysis: partitions the cart domain into 16 classes by the four independent binary rule triggers from rules.md, computes each class's total discount, and identifies the all-four-active class as the unique domain maximizer (0.4186), i.e. the only class on which the 40% claim can turn.

Child bundle proposing an isolated, uncontaminated fresh worker to perform the E-B systematic search (adversarial_searcher) over the whole cart domain and return a violating cart or impossibility argument, plus the deterministic integration rule mapping its deliverable to result.json's verdict and violating_input. Authored as an observable proposal; realization/search/integration are root-executed.
